```{r}
#| label: setup

source("setup.R")
fits <- get_fits()
```

# Convergence diagnostics

```{r}
#| label: tbl-convergence
#| tbl-cap: "Convergence diagnostics for all parameters of each model."
convergence <- function(fit) {
  s <- summarise_draws(as_draws_df(fit), "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail")
  np <- nuts_params(fit)
  tibble(
    max_rhat = max(s$rhat, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ess_bulk = min(s$ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ess_tail = min(s$ess_tail, na.rm = TRUE),
    divergences = sum(np$Value[np$Parameter == "divergent__"]),
    max_treedepth_hits = sum(np$Value[np$Parameter == "treedepth__"] >= 10)
  )
}
bind_rows(lapply(specs$model, function(m) mutate(convergence(fits[[m]]), model = m, .before = 1))) |>
  kable(digits = c(0, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0))
```

# Posterior predictive checks

```{r}
#| label: fig-ppc-dens
#| fig-cap: "Posterior predictive density overlays."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
wrap_plots(lapply(specs$model, function(m) {
  pp_check(fits[[m]], type = "dens_overlay", ndraws = 100) + labs(title = m)
}), ncol = 2) + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-ppc-stat
#| fig-cap: "Posterior predictive checks for the standard deviation and the minimum and maximum."
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 9
wrap_plots(lapply(specs$model, function(m) {
  (pp_check(fits[[m]], type = "stat", stat = "sd", bins = 30) + labs(title = m)) |
    pp_check(fits[[m]], type = "stat_2d", stat = c("min", "max"))
}), ncol = 1)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-ppc-loo-pit
#| fig-cap: "LOO-PIT Q-Q plots."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
wrap_plots(lapply(specs$model, function(m) {
  pp_check(fits[[m]], type = "loo_pit_qq", ndraws = 1000) + labs(title = m)
}), ncol = 2)
```

# Residuals over time

```{r}
#| label: fig-resid
#| fig-cap: "Residuals over time per state and their lag-1 autocorrelation."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
resid_df <- bind_rows(lapply(specs$model, function(m) {
  cigar |>
    mutate(model = m, resid = log_sales - colMeans(posterior_epred(fits[[m]])))
}))
lag1 <- resid_df |>
  arrange(model, state, year_full) |>
  group_by(model, state) |>
  summarise(acf1 = cor(resid[-1], resid[-n()]), .groups = "drop")
(ggplot(resid_df, aes(year_full, resid, group = state)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.3) +
    facet_wrap(~ model, nrow = 1) +
    labs(x = "Year", y = "Residual")) /
  (ggplot(lag1, aes(acf1)) +
     geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
     facet_wrap(~ model, nrow = 1) +
     labs(x = "Lag-1 autocorrelation within state", y = "States"))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-acf
#| tbl-cap: "Median lag-1 autocorrelation of residuals within a state."
lag1 |>
  group_by(model) |>
  summarise(median_acf1 = median(acf1)) |>
  kable(digits = 2)
```
